purpose: Mandatory AI/new-chat operating contract. Prevents repeated engineering work, parallel executors and loss of proven API knowledge.

permanent_rules.rule: Resume from current checkpoint/active gate. Never rerun an earlier PASS gate unless dependency/staleness evidence explicitly invalidates it.
PROVEN FIRST: before writing SOLIDWORKS/API code, query the proven capability registry and inspect the exact proven source. Reuse/adapt before creating a parallel implementation.
A proven capability must freeze all transitive executable sources (Python/C#/VBA/CMD/etc.) with SHA-256 and evidence. An outer wrapper alone is not a complete freeze.
For adapted reuse, preserve the proven core byte-for-byte where possible. Change only current authority/hash/input adapters; record the proven-core SHA in run evidence.
Engineering characteristic binding and API primitive are separate concepts. Composite bindings require an explicit deterministic selector/input contract; never assume len(entities)==1.
Installed SOLIDWORKS 2018 interop DLL + local compiler are the exact C# signature authority. Web docs are semantic reference, not guaranteed local marshaling syntax.
Canonical/stable native CAD is never the first write target. Compile/preflight -> timestamped candidate -> write -> save -> close -> reopen -> semantic/geometry/assembly QA -> explicit promotion.

SOLIDWORKS API return booleans are diagnostic only when proven anomalous. Engineering PASS comes from semantic readback, persistent-reference resolution, geometry/assembly invariance and explicit acceptance criteria.
For PMI-only writes, file SHA may change but solid geometry fingerprint must remain invariant. Canonical source SHA must remain unchanged during candidate-only authoring.
Use analytic geometry parameters and persistent references for engineering identity. IFace2.GetBox is approximate and not a tolerance-level acceptance primitive.
Materials are explicit at every part/release review. Unknown material is OPEN; never infer it. P007 material currently controlled as AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.
Preserve rejected alternatives and reasons in change control/backlog; do not erase design history.
Complex non-axisymmetric parts require full professional drawing + exact/native 3D reference from the controlled source. DXF is mainly for simple 2D/axisymmetric items.

Center is a materialized human view, not engineering authority. Engineering control/evidence -> generated feeds -> Center. Center actions delegate to canonical run.cmd routes; no second status/graph/BOM/CAD executor.
No automatic relocation of existing files/folders. No automatic C: or %LOCALAPPDATA% project destination. Copy/freeze is allowed only to declared D:/repo locations.
Git changes are surgical. Do not use git add -A on the historically dirty repo. Git/history is evidence and continuity, not product authority.
Screening PASS must never be silently promoted to release PASS. OPEN acceptance requirements stay OPEN and block the relevant release only.
Handoff archive is transport/resume context, not product authority. Native SOLIDWORKS binaries are indexed, not packed.
2D drawing is a derivative presentation of controlled product definition; do not create a second independent dimensional authority.
Released drawing dimensions/GD&T should originate in native DimXpert/PMI or another controlled model annotation. Manual layout is allowed; manual retyping of released semantic values is not.

For K01-D-006 preserve/refine the existing linked SLDDRW. Rejected mechanisms (SW2018 PropertyManager DimXpert UI automation and V7 direct drawing-entity auto-dimensioning) are not retried as primary paths. Drawing projection must consume the compiled Product Definition contract and registered CAD/PMI context; manual work is visual last-mile only.
Professional drawing quality has two gates: automated semantic QA and human visual QA. File creation alone is not a professional-drawing PASS.
Project/debug/open-item tables belong in workpacks/inspection evidence, not on the final manufacturing sheet unless the controlled drawing standard explicitly requires them.
Use one controlled title block and property-linked document metadata. Never use a full native filename as visible drawing title/number.

PRODUCT DEFINITION FIRST: before any drawing-authoring implementation, run the Product Definition guard. Drawing work is prohibited unless DRAWING_CANDIDATE_READY=PASS; release is prohibited unless DRAWING_RELEASE_READY=PASS.

Drawing/inspection code may consume only the compiled Product Definition contract for engineering values. Raw legacy candidate_spec text, template/general tolerances, drawing free text and PDF text are non-authorities.

Any execution-method pivot must atomically update K01_NEXT_ACTIONS_CURRENT, relevant architecture/policy, DECISION_LOG, K01_EXECUTION_METHOD_REGISTRY_CURRENT and an acceptance gate/test before the new implementation is attempted.

Same-mechanism failure budget is two bounded attempts. After the second failure, stop implementation and perform architecture review. Repackaging/renaming a rejected mechanism does not reset the budget.
Every downstream generated artifact must carry or reference the compiled Product Definition fingerprint and source fingerprints so staleness/drift can be derived.
OPEN is a controlled engineering state. No assistant/tool/CAD default may replace OPEN with a numeric tolerance, fit, GD&T, roughness, process or acceptance value.

The Center must expose Requirement -> Decision/Evidence -> Characteristic -> CAD/PMI -> Drawing -> Inspection traceability and readiness blockers, but remains a derived UI/orchestrator and never edits engineering authority directly.

AUTHORITATIVE DAG FIRST: before Class A/B implementation or any claim that prior work remains valid, use Authority Map -> engineering_build_graph and current MEDTAS derived state. Legacy K01_DEPENDENCY_STATE.json / K01_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH_v2.json are compatibility only.

Every Class A/B change declares an engineering entity and change domain, runs pre-change impact, and records direct seeds, transitive consumers, counterpart reviews and topological rebuild/reverification order before write.
Shared-interface changes never auto-edit counterpart parts. All controlled participants become COUNTERPART_REVIEW_REQUIRED; design mutation requires its own engineering decision/change record.

Freshness is fingerprint-derived. If a consumed upstream state hash changes, downstream build/verification records become STALE/FRESH_UNVERIFIED/DRIFT as computed. Never manually set PASS to bypass rebuild/reverification.

Automatic stale propagation is mandatory; automatic engineering mutation is not. Safe pure-derived compilers may rebuild automatically, while CAD/solver/release actions still require their registered producer/gate.

For design-review drawing projection, controlled PROJECTION_FALLBACK callouts are allowed only when generated from the compiled Product Definition and explicitly recorded per Cxx with source fingerprint and fallback class. They are not released dimensional/GD&T authority.

Drawing semantic projection coverage and drawing visual QA are separate gates. A semantically complete editable base may proceed to human 10-20% visual cleanup while release remains HOLD; visual cleanup may not invent or alter engineering semantics.

A drawing projection compiler must fail closed if safe_projection_ids are not fully represented or if the consumed compiled_definition_sha256 differs from the current drawing authoring gate. It must never recover by reading legacy drawing text or candidate_spec.

BINDING INVARIANCE: PMI existence/save-reopen is not enough. Release-critical geometry bindings require the declared L2/L3 rebuild/perturbation qualification; runtime face indices are non-authoritative.
ANALYSIS SPLIT: physics/behavior evidence and variation/tolerance/process-capability evidence are separate dependency domains and must not be invalidated/reused as if interchangeable.

FEEDBACK LOOP: downstream manufacturing/analysis/drawing/inspection problems create EFR/change-control feedback and reopen the upstream decision. No downstream artifact silently fixes upstream Product Definition.
INSPECTION SEQUENCE: inspection method/capability is part of S2 characteristic definition; S6 contains released procedures and actual results only.
CONFIGURATION/EFFECTIVITY: every released characteristic/artifact states applicable revision/baseline/effectivity. Historical released definitions are immutable.
MANUFACTURING FEASIBILITY: process/supplier capability and route selection precede release of process-dependent tolerances, roughness, joining notes and MBOM route.
DOMAIN SLICE FRESHNESS: consumers depend on the narrowest Product Definition slice sufficient for their function; avoid both under-invalidation and unnecessary full-project rebuilds.

D2 AUTHORIZATION IS CLAIM-SCOPED: manufacturing-route/process/supplier OPEN blocks only claims whose declared route dependency requires it plus release. It must not blanket-block route-independent CONTROLLED claims.

MANUAL EXEMPLAR BEFORE D5: use one bounded P007/D006 exemplar on dedicated copies to record actual SW2018 annotation-view/import/layout behavior. Do not write D5 release-native automation ahead of exemplar evidence.

ANNOTATION VIEW IS CLAIM CONTEXT: normalized annotation-view role is defined per claim in Product Definition; actual SOLIDWORKS annotation-view identity/orientation is D2/D3 evidence. One Cxx may legitimately span multiple views.

EXEMPLAR IS NOT RELEASE: V10 design-review projection and V12 manual exemplar may be semantically useful but cannot satisfy D3/D4/D7/D8/D9 release gates by status naming, visual appearance or returncode=0.

D3 THEN D7 ON THE SAME EXEMPLAR: after V12 native transport PASS, do not regenerate D006. Verify model PMI/binding first, then run drawing semantic QA. Presentation-only D7 defects are fixed on the same V12 SLDDRW.

D3 IS LAYERED: L1 save/reopen and L2 ForceRebuild may close first-exemplar assurance. L3 perturb/restore is release-critical and may run only after a real benign P007 parameter, allowed delta and restore acceptance are controlled; never guess a perturbation.

D7 EXEMPLAR PASS IS BOUNDED: it proves only the currently authorized C01/C02/C09 drawing scope. It cannot close open Product Definition claims, configuration/effectivity, D3 L3, D8 visual QA or D9 release.
D7 is a defect list, not an authoring authority. If fixing a D7 finding requires changing nominal/tolerance/fit/GD&T/datum/material/process semantics, stop drawing edits and open EFR/change control.

Before any mutation or stage transition, cross-layer assurance coherence must be machine-proven across authority -> executor -> evidence -> graph/derived state -> handoff. Current artifacts may not be reinterpreted through changed *_CURRENT inputs without explicit fingerprint requalification.

TEMPORAL PRECEDENCE: filename CURRENT is not global authority. Global STATE_CURRENT files must share K01_STATE_EPOCH_CURRENT; handoff must fail closed on temporal-coherence HOLD. Domain CURRENT files cannot override the Current Session Manifest.

input_contract.C02: From current canonical rebind binding, select the unique cylindrical entity radius 7.05 mm (Ø14.10).
input_contract.C05: C05 is composite. Select the unique cylindrical entity radius 16.50 mm (Ø33.00) from FLANGE_OD_PLUS_AXIAL_FACE_SET.

solidworks_current_proven_fact.known_anomaly: InsertSizeDimension may return False while native DimXpert feature/annotation is created; semantic reopen evidence is authoritative.

handoff_protocol.extra_native_file_rule: Upload the specific current SLDPRT/SLDASM/SLDDRW separately only when the next task requires direct native CAD inspection/modification; handoff ZIP intentionally excludes native SOLIDWORKS binaries.
handoff_protocol.proven_freeze_rule: RUN_FREEZE_PROVEN_API.cmd is NOT required for every new chat. Run it when a capability becomes newly PROVEN or the proven implementation/source set changes, then run handoff.
handoff_protocol.completion_rule: If K01_AI_HANDOFF_COMPLETENESS_CURRENT.json is HOLD, do not start engineering work in the new chat until missing required context/source is restored.

rules.rule: REQUIREMENT ALLOCATION FIRST: before a system/interface requirement drives part Product Definition, create/verify an allocation object identifying responsible entity/characteristic and share/budget/complementary responsibility. Requirement text is not copied into a part without allocation.

DERIVED INPUT IDENTITY: calculated/screening loads, preloads, reactions and intermediate values have stable DER-* identity, quantity kind, units, derivation/status and consumers. Equal numeric values never imply common requirement identity.

CHARACTERISTIC CONTEXT: Product Characteristics carry datum/reference-system semantics and declared measurement conditions where relevant. Thin-wall dimensions cannot be released with temperature/fixture/state/measurement-force applicability silently unspecified.

DRAWING DOMAIN FINGERPRINT: K01-D-006 projection consumes K01.PD.P007.DRAWING_SLICE and drawing_projection_sha256. Changes confined to physics/manufacturing/configuration/inspection slices do not force drawing regeneration unless graph-declared drawing inputs also change.

DRAWING TWO-LANE CONTROL: V10 PROJECTION_FALLBACK is design-review only. Release-native drawing semantics follow D1-D9 and require proven model carrier/provenance; never promote fallback text by visual cleanup.
CLAIM-LEVEL AUTHORING: plan annotation/drawing view by claim_id, not one annotation_view per whole characteristic. A Cxx may legitimately map to multiple views.

DIMXPERT TRANSPORT CAPABILITY: for SW2018 do not assume InsertModelAnnotations3/Model Items transports DimXpert. Use a capability-qualified native import method proven by exemplar evidence; rejected PropertyManager UI automation remains rejected.
D6 LAYOUT INVARIANCE: human layout/leader work must preserve semantic fingerprint. Any semantic delta opens EFR/change control.
D7 PROVENANCE: a drawing tolerance/GD&T is release-valid only when identity links characteristic/claim -> model PMI/native annotation -> drawing annotation. Numeric equality alone is not provenance.
GENERAL DEFAULTS CONDITIONAL: general tolerance/default roughness exists only if controlled Product Definition policy explicitly authorizes it. Template defaults never close OPEN.

rules: Before declaring a subsystem/domain complete, check K01_ENGINEERING_DOMAIN_REGISTRY_CURRENT and current coverage report; never omit FEMM, CalculiX/CCX, Flow/thermal/containment, tolerance, BOM/MBOM, inspection or configuration merely because the active chat is focused elsewhere.
Use exact controlled tool names in records: CalculiX/CCX, FEMM, SolidWorks Simulation/Flow Simulation. Solver evidence is downstream evidence, never Product Definition authority.
When introducing a new engineering discipline or solver, add its authority/evidence/fingerprint/stale-propagation contract to the domain registry and MEDTAS graph in the same controlled change.
